openwrt_wiki.einleitung: wireless router with MT7621 platform ... spec highly identical to Redmi AC2100. It runs Xiaomi Router firmware by default and ... requires a simple "PPPOE" or "Web Panel Shelling" exploit to start a shell and flash OpenWrt via command line interface.
openwrt_wiki.verwechslung: Do not mix up Redmi AC2100 with Xiaomi Mi Router AC2100 (Vergleichsbild media:xiaomi:rm2100-vs-r2100.jpg)
openwrt_wiki.installation_kurz: To install OpenWrt, you first need to get ssh access, then install OpenWrt from ssh. 2 methods: older firmware web exploit (recommended simpler method), pppoe exploit script
openwrt_wiki.stock_recovery: accepts stock signed firmware images from Xiaomi, in the form of PXE boot. Triggered by holding down the reset button while powering on, until the status light flashes amber. dnsmasq-Beispiel mit dhcp-range 192.168.31.50-150, dhcp-boot=test.bin, enable-tftp. After flashing the status light flashes white, then power-cycle.
openwrt_wiki.seriell: Requires soldering angled connectors. Connect RX pin on board to TX pin of adapter and vice versa, GND to GND. 115200, 8N1
